action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not all(isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) for arr in (logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must have the same shape")
    if np.any(np.isnan(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isnan(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isnan(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must not contain NaN")
    if np.any(np.isinf(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must be finite")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("logp inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized future-token weights (T01)
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)  # offset from first future token
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute weighted losses (T02)
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Stronger counterfactual baseline (T03)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Filtering threshold (T04)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
